text: My name is D-4172. They gave me one rule... don't blink.
A padded cell. A drain in the floor. A mop and a bucket. And in the corner... it.
Concrete. Rebar. Spray paint where a face should be.
It can't move while someone is looking at it.
So three of us go in. Two watch. One cleans.
The floor is always stained. Nobody tells us with what.
Forty seconds. My eyes are burning.
Next to me, my partner whispers: I'm blinking.
It's closer now. And my eyes... are watering.
